buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): RITES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: CONSIGNEE 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of SR DFM MDU payable at MADURAI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.Scope of supply: SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, TESTING,COMMISSIONING OF POWER GENERATOR 250 KVA

DG SET 3PH, 415V, 50HZ, WITH ACOUSTIC ENCLOSURE & AMF CONTROL PANEL 2.Documentary evidence /compliance statement addressing each point shall be uploaded along with the offer for technical evaluation purposes. Failure to submit the required documents / compliance details shall render the offer liable for rejection. 3.Bidders to provide product sheet and specification sheet of offered make and model along with the offer. Failing which offer may not be considered. 4.Warranty period : 3 years.- Warranty period preventive maintenance visits per year 2 times. 5.Functional Service Center:The Bidder / OEM must have a Functional Service Center in the State of Consig nee. The Functional Service Center shall be already established and fully operational at the respective loca tion at the time of bidding. Documentary evidence to be submitted at time of bidding Failing which offer m ay not be considered. 6.Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telep hone No.for Service Support. 7.OEM Authorization: The bidder must be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or a n authorized OE M partner/ dealer. In case the bidder is not the OEM, a valid Bid specific authorization certificate from the O EM must be uploaded along with the bid.The authorization must specifically mention the bid reference nu mber and confirm that the OEM will provide back to back warranty and support. 8.Past Performance: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should h ave supplied s ame or similar Category Products for 20% (ONE number).,in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU. Copies of relevant contracts an d CRN's (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. 9.For Make In India Preference Clause: Local content declaration along with percentage issued by OEM /ma nufacture has to be attached to be consider under MII clause. Local Content Declaration:The bidder shall declare the exact percentage of Local Content in clear numerical terms at the time of bid submission. The declaration shall be specific, unambiguous, and free from conditional or appr oximate expressions, and shall be supported by a valid self-certification and relevant documentary eviden ce as prescribed in the bid conditions. Any vague or non-specific declaration shall be treated as non-compli ant. 10.Following Certifications of the OEM must be uploaded: i)Conformity of production (COP) certificate of en gine issued in name of Engine manufacturer ii)Type test report and Endurance test report for Engine as pe r IS: 10001 latest / IS: 10002 latest. HMSO Certificate issued in name of DG manufacturer. 11.Payment 100% Payment will be done after the Supply, Installation and Commissioning of the DG and su bjected to submission of Bank Guarantee to consignee @ 5% of contract value with validity up to 38 mont hs. 12.Payment Condition (CMC): Comprehensive Maintenance: Comprehensive Maintenance Duration (Post W arranty) is 5 Y ear. The basic cost of the equipment shall be paid upon successful supply, installation, and acceptance. The Comprehensive Maintenance Contract (CMC) charges shall be payable separately and onl y after completion of the warranty period, on a yearly basis, subject to satisfactory performance of services. For bid evaluation purposes, CMC charges are considered along with the equipment cost; however, payme nt of CMC shall not be made up front nor included in the initial product payment. 13.Inspection by RITES (Firm to please mention the place of inspection with full address and pin code).
